scenes.headline: How a terminal agent trains its own successor
scenes.sub: Terminal-RSI: rewrite verified successes, refine with PPO, repeat.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Quoin! Here is how one terminal agent helps train the next one, twice over.

scenes.text: Turn your own verified successes into training data, refine with PPO, then let the improved model do the next rewrite.
scenes.mark: let the improved model do the next rewrite
scenes.say: The idea: turn your own verified successes into training data, refine with reinforcement learning, and let the improved model do the next round.

steps.say: The current model attempts terminal tasks under several harnesses. Each task's tests keep only the passing runs.
It writes each success as a runbook, then solves the task again in a fresh sandbox, the runbook kept out of the log.
Verified re-solves become fine-tuning data. Only the actor changes here.
Then comes PPO. The inherited critic catches up alone for four updates, then both train on the verifier's reward.
The kept checkpoint becomes the next generation, and it does the next round of rewriting.

parts.say: S is strict success: the whole test suite passed.
Passed checks earn a bonus that never reaches one, so any success outranks any failure.

left.title: PPO from the base model
left.say: Run PPO straight from the base model, and a sparse test reward has nothing to push on.

right.title: Rewrite first, then PPO
right.say: Rewrite first, and there are successes to reinforce.

steps.say: On Terminal-Bench two point one, the second rewrite stage reaches eighty-six point five two. The last PPO stage adds nothing.

scenes.title: Four-suite mean success
scenes.note: cycle two adds about a quarter of cycle one
scenes.say: Over four suites, the first cycle adds about twenty-four points. The second, about six.
The post calls it a new state of the art. On the paper's own chart, five models score higher on Terminal-Bench four.

scenes.text: Rewriting manufactures the first successes that RL needs; the second cycle added about a quarter of the first.
scenes.mark: the first successes that RL needs

recap: The next model does the next rewrite
scenes.say: To recap: rewrite verified successes, refine with an inherited critic, and let the new model rewrite next.
